---
title: "D.2. An SEIR model with two SES states"
output: rmarkdown::html_document
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{D.2. An SEIR model with two SES states}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

The XML of an SEIR model with an additional SES dimension ('low' and 'high' SES states) in which the duration and the infectivity of the I stage depend on SES [see the comments between `<!-- and`--\> ]:

``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<TB.Vx.model.inputfile xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../TB-Vx-schema-T.xsd">
  <simulation from.year="2020" thru.year="2021" dt="0.02">
    <options>
      <numerical.integration/>
    </options>
    <demography country.code="ignored" rescale.population="2050">
      <from.data>
        <population file="data/demographics.csv"/>
        <birthrate from.population.data="true"/>
        <mortality file="data/deathrates.csv"/>
      </from.data>
    </demography>
  </simulation>
  <output>
   <detailed.output years="2020+(0:50)*0.02" age.group.lower.limits="c(0,15)">
      <flows dim="TB" transmission="true" progression="true"/>
      <flows dim="HIV"/>
      <flows dim="VXa"/>
    </detailed.output>
  </output>
  <ages lower.limits="5*(0:15)"/>
  <VXa> <VXa.stages> <stage name="NA"/></VXa.stages></VXa>
  <!-- added low and high SES -->
  <SES> 
   <SES.stages> 
      <stage name="low" fraction.at.birth="0.4"/>
      <stage name="high" fraction.at.birth="0.6"/>
   </SES.stages>
  </SES>
  <RISK><RISK.stages><stage name="NA"/></RISK.stages></RISK>
  <HIV> <HIV.stages> <stage name="NA"/></HIV.stages></HIV>
  <TB>
    <TB.stages>
      <stage name="S" />
      <!-- added E -->
      <stage name="E" />
      <stage name="I" />
      <stage name="R" />
    </TB.stages>
    <seeded.infections name="multiplier" value="1">
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.01" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="I"/>
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.00" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="E"/>
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.00" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="R"/>
    </seeded.infections>
    <TB.progression>
      <TB.parameter name="dexposed" value="5" />
      <!-- duration of infectious stage depends on SES (low SES: less access to health care)-->
      <TB.parameter SES.stage="low"  name="d" value="14" />
      <TB.parameter SES.stage="high" name="d" value="7" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="E" to="I" rate="1/(dexposed/365.2425)" />
        <transition from="I" to="R" rate="1/(d/365.2425)" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.progression>
   <TB.infectivity>
      <!-- infectivity depends on SES (low SES: generally less healthy)-->
      <TB.parameter SES.stage="low"  name="infc" value="1." /> 
      <TB.parameter SES.stage="high" name="infc" value="0.8" /> 
      <infectivity.matrix>
        <infectivity stage="I" value="infc" />
      </infectivity.matrix>
    </TB.infectivity>
    <TB.transmission>
    <TB.parameter name="bc" value="0.4" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="S" to="E" rate="bc" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.transmission>
  </TB>
</TB.Vx.model.inputfile>
```
